CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD= 'Shruti@10-1988' 

------------------------------------
--DATABASE SCOPED CREDENIAL
------------------------------------ 
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL shru_creds
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

-----------------------------------
-- EXTERNAL DATA SCOURCE--
-----------------------------------
 
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE silver_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://azuredwlake.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/',
    CREDENTIAL = shru_creds
)

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE gold_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://azuredwlake.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/',
    CREDENTIAL = shru_creds
)

-------------------------------------
-- EXTERNAL File FORMAT
-------------------------------------
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT delta
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELTA
)
